name: 連結直列＋右側並排直式雙圖
desc: 左欄是多個連結列排成的直列，每列下方有分隔線；右側兩張直式圖片並排靠右，兩欄靠下對齊。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊，上方留白明顯大於下方。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，分成左右兩欄、兩欄靠下對齊，中間留一段空白：左欄約佔四成寬度，右欄約佔四成寬度並靠右。左欄是多個項目排成的直列，每列一筆：大標題在左，緊接在右邊放較小的次要說明文字，列的最右端放一個箭頭小圖示，整列是一個連結；每一列下方有一條分隔線，第一列上方沒有線。右欄放兩張並排、同樣大小的直式圖片，圖片組的上緣明顯高於左欄的第一列，下緣與左欄最後一條分隔線齊平。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，兩張並排的直式圖片在上、直列在下。圖片組靠右對齊，約佔內容寬度六成，左側留空；直列橫跨內容寬度，每列的組成與分隔線不變。上方留白仍明顯大於下方。

en.name: Link list of rows with a pair of portrait images on the right
en.desc: The left column is a list of link rows, each with a divider below; on the right, two portrait images sit side by side, aligned right, and the two columns are bottom-aligned.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content, with noticeably more space above than below. The content is aligned to the page content width and split into two bottom-aligned columns with empty space between them: the left column takes about forty percent of the width, and the right column takes about forty percent and is aligned right. The left column is a list of rows of multiple items, one per row: a headline on the left, a smaller secondary description placed directly to its right, and a small arrow icon at the far right end of the row; the whole row is a link. Each row has a divider below it, with no divider above the first row. The right column holds two portrait images of the same size side by side; the top edge of the image pair sits well above the first row of the left column, and its bottom edge lines up with the last divider of the left column.
en.mobile: Switch to a vertical stack, with the two side-by-side portrait images on top and the list of rows below. The image pair is aligned right and takes about sixty percent of the content width, leaving the left side empty; the list spans the content width, and each row keeps the same parts and divider. The space above remains noticeably larger than the space below.
